text:
raja (People Ops): Quick micro-kit: SMART goal phrasing, 90-day improvement plan template, interviewer scheduling snippet, and a tiny calibration anchor set. Paste into 1:1s or review comments.

ella (Eng Manager): love it. can you show a SMART-framed self-review goal and a manager version?

raja (People Ops): SMART SELF-REVIEW GOAL (example)
- "Goal: Improve feature reliability. Specific: reduce client-facing error rate on embeddings API. Measurable: lower error rate from 0.8% to 0.2%. Achievable: implement retry + input validation. Relevant: improves trust for enterprise customers. Time-bound: by end of Q3."

raja (People Ops): MANAGER SMART PHRASE (one line)
- "[Name] will reduce customer-facing errors for the embeddings endpoint from 0.8% to 0.2% by end of Q3 by owning retries, improving validation, and running pre-release tests. Check-ins every 2 weeks."

monica (People Ops): 90-DAY IMPROVEMENT PLAN (copyable)
- Week 0: agree scope + baseline metric. Week 2: deliver plan (milestones + risks). Week 4: first milestone complete, 2-week check-in. Week 8: midpoint review + stakeholder demo. Week 12: final review, measure delta, next steps.

ella (Eng Manager): useful. any short phrasing to set expectations without sounding punitive?

raja (People Ops): TONE-FRIENDLY TIMELINE SNIPPET
- "Well run this plan for 90 days with biweekly check-ins; the goal is to remove roadblocks and measure progress together."

nick (Hiring Ops): can you add a short coord snippet for scheduling interview panels and a calibration note for interviewers?

raja (People Ops): HIREOPS SCHEDULING SNIPPET (for panels)
- "Please propose 3 times in the next 5 business days; Hiring Ops will confirm and circulate panel prep notes. If a panelist cancels within 24h, well reschedule rather than replace without notice."

raja (People Ops): INTERVIEWER CALIBRATION NOTE (one line)
- "Quick anchor: PASS = solves system design + shows ownership examples; BORDERLINE = strong craft but unclear cross-team impact; NO = gaps in fundamentals or ownership. Stick to observable examples in feedback."

monica (People Ops): CALIBRATION ANCHORS (behavioral examples)
- Impact anchor: "Drove a rollout that reduced latency by 30% for 100k users" (High) vs "Implemented a bug fix for a single repo" (Low).
- Reliability anchor: "Consistently met milestones and helped others unblock" (High) vs "Missed multiple delivery dates" (Low).
- Collaboration anchor: "Led cross-team design sessions and aligned stakeholders" (High) vs "Worked in isolation" (Low).

ella (Eng Manager): can you include a short before/after metric phrasing for OKRs? makes summaries cleaner.

raja (People Ops): BEFORE/AFTER METRIC PHRASE (one line)
- "Before: median time-to-first-PR = 21d. After target: median time-to-first-PR = 10d (48% improvement)."

monica (People Ops): SELF-REVIEW PROMPTS (fresh set)
1) "One outcome you owned and the metric that changed."
2) "A decision you made that required tradeoffs  what did you prioritize and why?"
3) "Where you want more stretch next cycle and the concrete measure of success."
4) "Manager feedback: what do you need started/stopped/continued?"

reviews-bot: Reminder: Q-cycle window opens in 6 days. Use /start-review to submit drafts.

ella (Eng Manager): perfect, ill paste these into my review templates. thanks!

raja (People Ops): happy to make level-specific variants if folks want IC2/IC3/Senior/Staff phrasing. react :doc: to request.
